next_recommendation: COMPLEMENTARY ROLE CHARACTERIZED at max available scale (144k/22yr). Dense embeddings are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for two non-jurist-preference views: (1) Citation Heritage — center_projected_64dim AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74, minimal scale ~130k (21yr); (2) Section Cross-lingual — Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy, center_projected_64dim improves all sections 16-38%, full corpus BLOCKED pending section extraction; (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — PASS adversarial at 19yr+ with w=0.3-0.4, adds cross-lingual benefit but BELOW TF-IDF baseline on JP. TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY (JP 0.78); Dense = COMPLEMENTARY. Data blockers: bge_/bger_ ID mapping + parquet 2022-2026 + section extraction. Corpus lane resumption required for 174k completion. No further same-question cycles. Product v1.0 with TF-IDF primary; dense v1.1+ per integration contracts in report.

critical_findings.citation_heritage_dense_superior: Dense embeddings (center_projected_64dim) achieve AUC 0.79-0.85 for citation heritage recovery at 144k scale, SUPERIOR to TF-IDF citation-based (AUC 0.71-0.74) and much better than TF-IDF text-based (AUC 0.50-0.63). Capability emerges at ~130k (21yr) when sufficient cross-year citation pairs exist.
critical_findings.section_crosslingual_hierarchy: Sachverhalt (facts) superior cross-lingual alignment (cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282, invariance_gap=0.187), Dispositiv (holding) intermediate (0.150, 0.397), Erwaegungen (reasoning) poorest (0.094, 0.452). Center projection improves all sections 16-38%. Full corpus BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k.
critical_findings.linear_hybrid_optimal_weight: Weight sweep at 22yr (144k): optimal w=0.4 for cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.6725, LangDom=0.6539 PASS) and w=0.3 for outcome_hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.6605, LangDom=0.6395 PASS). Scale shifts optimal weight toward denser semantic contribution (w=0.3 at 19yr → w=0.4 at 22yr). Hybrids improve cross-lingual recall (0.124→0.160) but remain below TF-IDF baseline on JP (0.78).
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_fundamental: Reproduced at all scales (3yr/15yr/19yr/20yr/21yr/22yr): TF-IDF citation hybrids (LangDom~0.48, JP~0.78, CiteIndep~0.14) vs Dense semantic (LangDom~0.83-0.98, JP~0.05-0.43, CiteIndep~0.37). NO single representation dominates all three metrics.
critical_findings.true_oos_ceiling: v8 holdout validation confirms true OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Dense embeddings cannot be PRIMARY for jurist navigation.
critical_findings.tfidf_174k_primary_validated: TF-IDF citation hybrids (cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5) at 174k: JP=0.73-0.78, LangDom=0.48, PASS both adversarial gates. Beats simple semantic baseline (center_projected JP=0.43) satisfying mission.
